summary: Backend-only verification of the new GET /api/readings/latest/{customer_id} endpoint used by the frontend to auto-populate previous_reading on invoice creation. Added 7 new tests in TestLatestReading. Full pytest suite: 32/32 PASSED in 5.74s. Verified: (1) customer with NO readings -> {has_reading: false, current_reading: 0}; (2) customer with readings -> {has_reading: true, current_reading: <latest>, reading_date: ...}; (3) latest is picked by reading_date desc regardless of insertion order (tested both natural and reversed insertion); (4) PRD scenario reading1(100) -> reading2(200) returns current=200; (5) invalid/arbitrary customer_id string does not 500 and returns has_reading:false; (6) well-formed but non-existent ObjectId returns has_reading:false; (7) route ordering: /readings/latest/{cid} is NOT shadowed by /readings/{reading_id}. All existing endpoints (auth, customers, generators, expenses, reports/debts, reports/financial, reports/consumption, readings, invoices, payments, dashboard, amperage-removed, monthly-fee, etc.) remain green. No regressions.

minor.issue: response is not typed with a Pydantic response_model. Consider adding one for OpenAPI clarity.
reading_date is returned as raw datetime; JSON serialization is fine but a consistent ISO string would be safer for RN clients.
(carried over) total_amount is still client-supplied; server should compute total = consumption_charge + monthly_fee + previous_balance.
(carried over) No validation that amount > 0 and no overpayment guard.

action_items: Main agent can self-verify by opening the mobile app -> new invoice -> select an existing customer with prior readings; previous_reading should auto-populate to the last current_reading value.
Optional: add response_model to /readings/latest/{customer_id} for OpenAPI schema clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L322-336: endpoint is correctly placed BEFORE /readings/{reading_id} so route ordering is safe.
server.py L326: uses customer_id as string (matches how it is stored in db.readings). Good - no ObjectId cast so arbitrary strings do not raise.
server.py still uses Pydantic v1 .dict() and deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to .model_dump() and lifespan handlers (carried over).
Admin credentials hardcoded in server.py (carried over).
seed_data_creation: All new tests create TEST_ prefixed customers/readings and clean up via DELETE /api/customers/{id} in try/finally blocks. No permanent data added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/readings/latest/{customer_id} is defined in server.py L322-336 BEFORE /readings/{reading_id} (correct FastAPI route ordering). It queries db.readings by customer_id (string) sorted by reading_date desc, returning {has_reading, current_reading, reading_date} or {has_reading:false, current_reading:0}. Baseline: 32/32 pytest green. Known minor issues carried from iteration 4 remain (total_amount client-supplied; no payment amount>0 guard).
